decisions.reason: Because the net price display plugin remains closely related to the firm's core shop-extension and optimization know-how and can be improved with its own R&D, we would keep it, though its lower visibility suggests some risk of being folded into broader service packages or dropped if demand is modest.

Because the ERP system interface plugin builds directly on the firm's strongest integration capabilities and supports its multichannel commerce direction, the firm has high absorptive capacity to refine it and would keep it unless uptake clearly disappoints.
